headline: Electric Vehicles Outsell Gasoline and Diesel in Europe
meta_description: For the first time, electric vehicles have outsold gasoline and diesel cars in Europe, marking a major milestone in the continent's shift away from fossil fuel…
summary_short: A historic turning point: electric vehicles have now outsold traditional gasoline and diesel cars in Europe for the first time ever.
body:
For the first time, electric vehicles have outsold gasoline and diesel cars across Europe. This milestone marks a watershed moment in the continent's transition toward cleaner transportation and away from fossil fuels.

The achievement reflects years of growing investment in EV infrastructure, improving battery technology, and shifting consumer preferences. As charging networks expand and vehicle prices become more competitive, electric cars are no longer a niche choice—they've become the mainstream option.

This shift carries profound implications. Europe's auto industry, long defined by internal combustion engines, is fundamentally transforming. The transition promises cleaner air in cities, reduced emissions, and new economic opportunities in battery manufacturing and green technology sectors across the continent.
quick_facts: Electric vehicles outsold gas and diesel cars in Europe
First time this milestone has been reached in Europe
Marks major shift toward fossil fuel-free transportation
